en:
Wait a minute, Kokichi.
Miu couldn't have been killed with poison.

And it's much too early to decide
that Kaito is the culprit.

But whyyyyyyy?
I think it's already too late.

You guys are taking so long to realize
that people can kill others in a snap...

<CLT=cltMIND>I know Kokichi hasn't forgotten about
<CLT=cltSTRONG>that<CLT=cltMIND>. He's just pretending.

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, Kokichi. I'll play your game.
If you're going to lie, I will too.

Have you forgotten? The bottle we found
at the scene was an <CLT=cltSTRONG>antidote<CLT=cltNORMAL>, not a poison.

It's not like Miu could have been
killed by an antidote.

Whaaat? Are you serious here?
C'mon, Shuichi.

That bottle definitely had poison in it.
Didn't we check the label?

<CLT=cltMIND>I know that expression...
Kokichi is toying with me.

<CLT=cltMIND>He knows the flaw in his argument,
he's just pretending not to!

...Is this *fun* for you, messing with the
trial?

Hm? Well, I mean, this is where it gets
fun for both me and the culprit.
...So, what's this talk about an antidote?

We'll just say you misunderstood the whole
thing, Shuichi. We all know you wouldn't lie.

O-Of course. I'm sorry, I was
just misremembering.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't let Kokichi continue this line
of questioning. It will implicate Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why is Kokichi doing this?
I have no choice—I have to call him on it.
But Kokichi, you're misremembering as well.

You were the one who told us about the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>warnings<CLT=cltNORMAL> on the label.

If you remember what was on that label,
you'll see that your argument is flawed.

What warnings? Was there something like
that on the label?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is he still pretending
not to know...?
Um... So what does that mean?

It means that Miu couldn't have been killed
with poison. That's what I'm trying to say.

Um... What if you're mistaken
about the antidote, Shuichi?

Ah, right. Well, for now,
forget the antidote...

Let's focus on exactly what was
written on that warning label.

Miu wasn't killed by poison, and the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>warning<CLT=cltNORMAL> on the label proves it.

Drinking the poison would result in
subconjunctival hemorrhaging.
In other words, your eyes would be <CLT=cltSTRONG>bloodshot<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Oh, but Miu's body...

That's right! Her eyes weren't bloodshot!
She wasn't killed by that poison!
Then what was that poison for?

Probably a diversion. The culprit wanted us
to think Miu died by poison.
Then...what was her real cause of death?

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's real cause of death.
The only one I can think of...

By looking at her body, we can tell she
wasn't killed by the poison...
That's the only thing we do know.

Was there anything else that could
be the murder weapon?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Hey...
That's from the Virtual World.

Nee-heehee...you'd probably need a looot of time
explaining to Kaito, cuz of his thick-ass skull.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

If she wasn't poisoned, then what was it...?
Hmm... Her body wasn't injured, either.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Is that really the cause of Miu's death?
I don't understand...

Judging from the body, maybe the cause of
death wasn't located in the real world...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
What was Miu's cause of death?

Miu's cause of death was the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>killing game simulator<CLT=cltNORMAL> itself.

In the Virtual World, if your avatar takes
fatal damage, your real body dies of shock.

That was made clear in the
program's text file.

Miu received fatal damage in the
Virtual World and died from that shock...

In that case, it's fair to say that the
cause of death was actually the simulator.
Ummm... Gonta has question...

Where is this "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ver-chew-ul World<CLT=cltNORMAL>" place?
What floor is it on?

If you don't understand, then don't say
anything.

If Miu was killed in the Virtual World, then
the next thing we need to figure out...

is what caused her to incur fatal damage
within the Virtual World.

So her cause of death in the Virtual
World is the one that matters.
U-Ummm...

Oh, it seems like Gonta is confused,
so why don't we review things a bit?

Umm... So we split into two groups to 
find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The ones who searched the mansion were 
me, Shuichi, Tsumugi, Gonta, and...
...that NPC Kaito!
Hey! Who you callin' NPC, you A-S-S!?

And the others who searched the chapel were
Kee-boy, Maki, Himiko, and...the late Miu.

How could someone have given her
fatal damage in that situation?

That's what we gotta think about!
Now, let's all work together!

Aawww, li'l Himiko is all grown up! 
Too bad your chest hasn't grown up though.

That was uncalled for! Someday, 
my chest will grow like crazy!
...Let's begin, then.

<CLT=cltMIND>The fatal damage that Miu received
in the Virtual World...
<CLT=cltMIND>Let's pin that down.
